title: Closing a page item keeps the owner's saved answer, so a lane's relayed-grant check can still read it
why: Incident 13:52 CST Nov 12: triage closed item 618 and deleted answers/batch-label-allow-text (practice since 12:34 CST: closing deletes the answers doc); lane batch-label-setter's page_grant.py then printed "not counted: no saved answer", so the owner had to save again (item reopened 13:54 CST).
note: Fix: the page writer deletes an answers doc only on reopen or reword, never on close; a check in the writer path refuses a close that deletes it. Red first on the 618 sequence. Home: skill waiting-page. Lane started 14:52 CST Nov 12 (coordinator, from the batch 104 review). Lane 14:59 CST Nov 12: page_grant.py rule 4 refuses any closed non-arbiter decision (test_status_closed_decision_not_counted), so a relayed-grant check run after the close still fails, now as "status closed". Triage pick a, 15:01 CST: keep rule 4; a lane's checks run before the close. Option b would widen what the grant check accepts (a closed item's answer counts as a grant), so main's behaviour stands (rule building-port-keeps-behaviour); no page item. The park branch stays unchanged; the kept-answer line stays, and its remedy no longer says delete. Triage 20:07 CST Nov 13: carries the folded step close-keeps-grant-answer. Open draft PR #2981, head a91005a70a71 (coordinator REST read 20:06). The two cases that mattered: grant items 759, 753, 774 and 786 must keep their answer doc until the lane has fetched it. Gap from the folded lane (via the coordinator 20:09 CST Nov 13, read from diffs, unmeasured): #2981 changes SKILL.md prose and checks it, but #3264's --close-batch still prints an answer delete, so the two clash on merge. The coordinator told lane receipt-close-express.
